name: panel
title: Panel
description: A floating surface the reader moves, resizes, folds to its header and closes.
use: Tools that stay open beside the work while the page stays usable: the layers of a canvas, a color picker, an inspector, a chat. The reader drags it by its header, resizes it from its corner, folds it to its header and closes it; the application keeps where it was through the behavior's value.

instead.when: The task must be finished or dismissed before the page is used again
The content belongs to one button and leaves on an outside click
The surface keeps a place in the layout and two regions share the space
It is a picture of an application window, not a window that moves
It is a row of tools over content, with no title or body

keyboard.action: On a button with commandfor and command="toggle-popover": open the panel and move focus to its handle; again, close it
On the handle: move the panel a step, 16px, that way; it stops at the edges of the viewport
On the handle: move the panel four steps
On the handle: make the panel wider or narrower by a step, four with Shift; the other way around from right to left, where the corner it resizes from is at the left
On the handle: make the panel taller or shorter by a step, four with Shift; a folded panel keeps its height
On the minimize button: fold the panel to its header, or unfold it
With focus in the panel: close it and return focus to the control that opened it. A control inside that handles Escape, such as an open menu, keeps it
Move between the handle, the actions and the body, and on to the page: the panel is not modal

platform.feature: popover="manual" with commandfor and command="toggle-popover" (or popovertarget)
platform.fallback: Supported in all current browsers: the panel opens over the page in the top layer and closes from its button without script. Where no button can point at it, call showPopover() and hidePopover(); the stylesheet is the same
The panel appears and leaves at once, without the fade
Supported in all current browsers; without it a folded panel keeps its body and a held one its shadow

classes.name: panel
classes.description: The floating sheet: a popover="manual" with role="dialog", named by its title with aria-labelledby. It stands where --panel-x and --panel-y say, kept inside the viewport, 20rem wide unless told otherwise, at the top end corner when given no place

classes.name: panel-header
classes.description: The bar at the top: the title at the start, the actions at the end and the handle under both. It is the part that never leaves the viewport

classes.name: panel-handle
classes.description: A button the size of the header, first in it, that carries the panel: a drag anywhere on the bar that is not a control moves it, and the arrow keys move it while it has focus. Name it with what it moves and how, such as "Move the Layers panel with the arrow keys". Its focus rings the panel

classes.name: panel-title
classes.description: The title, on one line; point the panel's aria-labelledby at it. It takes no pointer, so a press on it reaches the handle

classes.name: panel-actions
classes.description: The controls at the end of the header, over the handle: small quiet square buttons

classes.name: panel-minimize
classes.description: The button that folds the panel to its header. Pressed, it sits in a well, and the body and the corner are hidden

classes.name: panel-body
classes.description: What the panel holds, under a hairline, with --panel-padding around it. A long body scrolls inside the panel. Lay out what it holds in an element inside it: the panel hides the body when it is folded

classes.name: panel-resize
classes.description: The corner a pointer resizes the panel from, at the bottom end: a 16px target, 44px on touch screens. The keys resize from the handle, so hide it from assistive technology

states.name: open
states.description: Shown by the browser, from its button or showPopover()

states.name: minimized
states.description: Folded to its header: the body and the corner are hidden and the panel is as tall as its header

states.name: held
states.description: Carried by the pointer, as is panel-resize: the panel rises to the overlay shadow and the drag selects no text

states.name: focused
states.description: The focus ring is drawn around the whole panel, the thing the keys move

states.name: disabled
states.description: A handle the page turned off, as is panel-resize with aria-disabled="true": the behavior moves or resizes nothing, the hand cursor is gone and the panel does not rise when pressed

properties.name: --panel-x
properties.description: The left edge, from the viewport's left edge; the script writes it in pixels. It is kept so the whole width stays in the viewport, at the right edge by default and at the left from right to left

properties.name: --panel-y
properties.description: The top edge, from the viewport's top edge; the script writes it in pixels. It is kept so the header stays in the viewport

properties.name: --panel-width
properties.description: The width; the script writes it in pixels. It is kept between --panel-min-width and the viewport's width

properties.name: --panel-height
properties.description: The height, as tall as the content by default; the script writes it in pixels. It is never more than the viewport's height

properties.name: --panel-min-width
properties.description: The narrowest a resize makes it

properties.name: --panel-gutter
properties.description: The least room kept between the panel and the edges of the viewport

properties.name: --panel-radius
properties.description: The corner: a small button's corner plus the 6px the header keeps around it
